env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.500
env TESTGO_VERSION_SWITCH=mismatch

# go env GOMOD should not trigger a toolchain download
cd $GKPATH/mod
go env GOMOD
stdout mod[/\\]go.mod
! stderr 'gecko: toolchain go1.500 invoked to provide go1.700'

# go env GKWORK should not trigger a toolchain download
cd $GKPATH/work
go env GKWORK
stdout work[/\\]go.work
! stderr 'gecko: toolchain go1.500 invoked to provide go1.700'

-- $GKPATH/mod/go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.700

-- $GKPATH/work/go.work --
module example.com

go 1.700
